name: caller-reputation-cti
description: Salesforce-connected calling app that protects your caller reputation

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace services/cti-api run dev
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace services/cti-api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm --workspaces --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm --workspaces --if-present run test
